prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-fidelity smartphone portrait of an approved adult woman in a moody domestic interior under warm amber light.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with dark brunette hair, almond-shaped eyes, natural skin micro-texture, a beauty mark above the right corner of her mouth, defined brunette-toned lip liner, separated lashes, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a dusty-rose/mauve ribbed strapless top, silver cross-shaped drop earrings with pearl studs, a thin silver chain with a cross pendant, and a nude-satin almond manicure. Her left hand rests against her cheek with the index finger near the mouth in a calm editorial gesture.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium close-up portrait angled slightly toward camera, sharp focus from foreground manicured nails to background hair texture, face and hand prominent, neutral domestic architecture behind with no artificial bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Single warm 2700K amber source creates orange-gold illumination, deep clean shadows, and an intimate moody domestic atmosphere while preserving realistic skin and hair texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 raw smartphone portrait, iPhone-style sensor simulation, f/2.8, zero artificial bokeh, high-contrast clarity, authentic digital grain, accurate hands and facial geometry, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw high-fidelity 9:16 smartphone portrait of an approved adult woman with dark brunette hair, almond-shaped eyes, realistic skin micro-pores and fine facial hair, a beauty mark just above the right corner of the mouth, separated volume lashes, defined brunette-toned lip liner, and a calm magnetic gaze directed toward the camera. She wears a dusty-rose mauve ribbed strapless top, silver cross-shaped drop earrings with pearl studs, a minimalist thin silver-link chain with a cross pendant, and a nude-satin almond manicure. Her left hand rests gently against her cheek with the index finger near the corner of the mouth, with realistic joints and natural skin texture. Compose a medium close-up angled slightly toward camera, sharp from the manicure to the hair texture, in a neutral domestic interior under a single warm 2700K amber light. Use iPhone-style sensor simulation, f/2.8, zero artificial bokeh, high-contrast clarity, deep clean shadows, authentic digital grain, and no AI smoothing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped anatomy, distorted face, artificial bokeh, text, logo
